notes: §1985:VI.6.12.3 SR3: 'The sentence ENTER COBOL must follow the last other-language statement'. The antecedent cannot occur: every ENTER sentence, the other-language one and the ENTER COBOL return alike, is refused at 85 with COBOL7240 (kb/Work PB5308), so no other-language text is compiled in-line and none can run as COBOL; witness: the refusal 1985-SR-VI_6_12_3-3 (refuse-at 85, COBOL7240).

next.reason: 1985: "The sentence ENTER COBOL must follow the last other-language statement"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the ENTER statement; no candidate covers other-language entry or ENTER COBOL". No 2023 clause covers the ENTER statement, and no worded candidate addresses returning to COBOL from other-language statements. The feature is absent from 2023.
